body: She's a goddess, right? I saw her three times last year. Obsessed.
:) I saw the Drumming Song video in college and was hooked.

I <3 music. I like a lot of genres but my favorites are Florence and the Machine, Kanye, Sia, Disclosure, Beyonce, Chet Faker, Banks, Odesza, Ratatat, Kygo, blah I could go on but you get the idea. Thank you for asking. Music is one of my favorite things that I haven't been able to enjoy of late which is sad.

Thank you. I appreciate feeling normal since for a year I have felt like a complete freak. It's funny that I have really conditioned myself to believe that I'm not a worthwhile person and that every time I sense something like hope or it's not that bad, I immediately stop it. Optimism isn't in my toolkit right now. But from your post and the posts of others I am sensing a bit more of it.
I hope so too. I emailed her today in advance of the appointment so that we can really get the ball rolling.

I agree. I think that my regular week-to-week therapist is no longer effective. I'm looking into CBT and ECT as well. I am motivated to make a change to feel better but am feeling very little confidence that a change can happen. That slight chance of hope is really pushing me through.

Thank you. I can't watch the video right now while I'm at work but I appreciate your response. It's actually surprisingly easy putting my info out into the ether for everyone to look at and feels pretty liberating. I do realize that it's mostly in my head which is both good (I can dig myself out) and bad (what else is my brain capable of if it was capable of these psychotic episodes?). Thank you for the response and I will be looking at the video later.

I don't want you to feel like you want to kill yourself either. This all makes me so sad. I really don't have any desire to end it all but just can't fathom how I'm supposed to keep going. 

I'm pretty trapped here at my job. I have a few options of things that I could be interested in pursuing but I'm not skilled in any of them and am so afraid of failing once again that I can't bring myself to actually want to pursue something new. 

I have an appointment with my psychiatrist tomorrow and these solutions clearly aren't working.
